name: gov.pt
dev: AGÊNCIA PARA A REFORMA TECNOLÓGICA DO ESTADO, I.P.

android.desc:
State app for digital documents, public services and authentication.

Portuguese public administration app that allows you to store identification documents, manage the Digital Mobile Key, sign documents and perform public services (replaces the old id.gov.pt and autenticacao.gov apps).

Digital documents

The app works as a digital wallet. You can add your official identification documents (Citizen's Card, driving license, among others), which have the same legal value as physical documents.

Authentication

You can manage your Digital Mobile Key, sign PDF documents and activate your Citizen Card certificates.

Citizen Card Renewal

You can request the renewal of your Citizen Card through the app.  

Paperless invoices

You can opt for paperless invoices and start receiving invoices by email, sent to your taxpayer, at participating establishments.

More digital services will be launched soon.
